name: billsensei/moodle-repository_mediabank
description: Media bank for Moodle 5.0 to 5.3: upload a video, audio file, PDF or picture to the Content bank once and use it in many courses, as a link or a copy.

scripts-descriptions.build: Build the two plugin zips and the bundle zip into ./dist (reproducible).
scripts-descriptions.validate-zip: Run Moodle's installer validation on a plugin zip: --moodle=<path> --zip=<file> --component=<name>.
